name: hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r4s-ctlr4s-COMMIT
purpose: Deep strap QUANT transport controller for the d4g split r3: GEN2e4 r11 needs RL 54 at hb_quant_NW (RLI 58+2XR), ctl_r3 takes RLI <= 46. Command metadata ring in one 128x64 1R1W SRAM. Bench = split r3 lockstep vs the monolith at L 7 / 54, XR 0 / 12.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r4 #(.WCMAX(64), .DL(25), .MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/static/ot_hgi_qdq_transport_r4.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x64_m1_p192/ot_sram_1r1w_128x64_m1_p192_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: QDQ_SPLIT_R3_mutant_ring_late
bench.why: ctl_r4 ring read address one entry late (MUT 3): rsel / dst / header one command off

bench.name: QDQ_SPLIT_R3_mutant_unpriced_relay
bench.why: L 54, 12 relay stages present, straps priced for 11

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r4s/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r4s/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r4s --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r4 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x64_m1_p192 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: ctl r4: ctl_r3 (strap latency, pin capture registers, reset relay, closed TT +127.80 / FF +14.92) with the 46-bit command metadata pipeline sp/dp/hp moved from a 48-deep flop shift register into a 128-entry ring in one ot_sram_1r1w_128x64_m1_p192 (write every edge at wp, read at wp+1-RLI; rd = tap NP-3, two flop stages = tap NP-1); vp/lp stay reset flops. RLI 2..126 covers the GEN2e4 die need RL 54 (RLI 58 + 2*XR); flop pipeline at NP 128 would be ~5.9 kb (> 2 kb storage rule).
